description: This source file defines serializers and copiers for Nullable<T> types in Orleans.Serialization. It includes a NullableCodec<T> class for serializing/deserializing nullable value types and a NullableCopier<T> class for object copying, both tailored for use with 'struct' types.

classes.name: NullableCodec<T>
classes.description: Serializer for Nullable<T> types, handling null and non-null values during serialization.

classes.name: NullableCopier<T>
classes.description: Copier for Nullable<T> types, supporting deep copy semantics.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a nullable value, writing a null reference if the value is null; otherwise, delegates to the inner field codec.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes a nullable value, reading a null reference or delegating to the inner field codec.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidReference
methods.description: Throws an exception if an invalid reference is encountered during deserialization.

methods.name: NullableCopier
methods.description: Constructor to initialize the copier with a specific deep copier for T.

methods.name: IsShallowCopyable
methods.description: Indicates whether the copier supports shallow copying.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Performs a deep copy of a nullable value, delegating to the inner copier if available.
